versions.changelog:
scheme-generation-design-writing v1.0.1

- 新增 config.json，支持灵活配置项目和输出路径等参数
- 所有文档中将“Codex”替换为“OpenClaw”，保持平台一致性
- 项目结构和依赖说明细节优化，README、PROJECT_STRUCTURE等文档同步更新
- 移除 skill-card.md，文档结构更简洁
- 更新用例和操作指引，提升可读性和易用性

v1.0.0 (2026-05-27)

- Initial release of scheme-generation-design-writing skill
- Supports automated generation of concept proposals and design documentation (.docx)
- Enables intelligent project matching based on historical materials and requirements
- Integrates with Figma for design specification extraction
- Outputs professional Word files with multi-style options
- Minimal codebase, non-reliant on complex dependencies
